For one independent randomized complex test arm, depict an original adult fictional woman as a clearly legible maritime police or coast guard professional during dawn storm-debris recovery around a disabled sailboat, using the attached portrait only as visible facial and hair appearance guidance.

At dawn after a storm, one original adult fictional woman serving as a maritime police or coast guard officer works on the wet deck of a marked coastal patrol boat beside a disabled sailboat among floating branches. She wears a high-visibility waterproof flotation jacket over a dark operational duty uniform, a fastened buoyancy vest, a radio microphone, weatherproof gloves, a utility belt, and deck boots. Her long dark softly waved hair is secured in a low ponytail, while her visible facial appearance follows the attached portrait only as guidance for a new fictional subject. Braced against the rail, the officer secures a recovery line as a second partially visible crew member transfers one rescued adult in an orange life jacket from the sailboat. A taut line and clipped rescue sling visibly connect the officer's hand, the patrol boat, and the transfer. Broken branches drift around slack rigging; sea spray beads on gear. Documentary maritime-rescue photography, wide three-quarter view, dawn light breaking through rain clouds, with enough body and vessel context to read the uniform, equipment, action, and recovery consequence.

obligation.composition_instruction: Preserve the requested adult fictional identity, role, wardrobe, and visual style. In one still, keep a calm low-expression baseline visibly stable while one concrete, quiet practical action helps one identifiable trusted adult counterpart and leaves an already-visible helpful consequence for that same counterpart. Add only one localized warmth leak, such as slight lower-lid easing, a restrained brow release, a fractional mouth-corner softening, or reduced tension in the hand or shoulder nearest the target. Optional outward support may use economical gesture, stable upright posture, a neat simple silhouette, restrained grooming, or a muted/cool-neutral palette, but these are conventions rather than requirements. Do not assign fixed hair color, eye color, hairstyle, costume, gender, occupation, gaze direction, camera angle, or prop, and do not let expressionlessness, competence, beauty, a cool palette, or a caring object substitute for the same-target action and consequence. Preserve the counterpart's autonomy; avoid hostile denial, shy withdrawal, possessive control, broad open affection, or an abrupt personality switch.
